title: Embedded Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Sonepar is an independent, family-owned global leader in B2B distribution of electrical equipment, solutions, and services, with operations in 40 countries and sales of €33.6 billion in 2025. The Group is driving a major transformation to offer customers an omnichannel experience and sustainable solutions across building, industry, and energy markets. In India, Sonepar focuses on industrial and commercial sectors, providing electrical equipment, technical services, and solutions for telecom, industrial automation, networking, renewable energy, lighting, power distribution, and more. Supported by a strong logistics network of warehouses and offices, product specialists and engineers deliver innovative, durable products along with training and customized solutions. Certified as a “Great Place To Work,” Sonepar India offers a collaborative environment for professionals seeking growth in a future-focused organization.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Research and Development Engineer role based in Gandhinagar. The R&D Engineer will design, develop, and improve electrical products and solutions aligned with Sonepar’s industrial and commercial markets. Daily responsibilities include conducting research on materials, technologies, and market needs, performing testing and validation of prototypes, analyzing performance data, and documenting findings. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams such as product management, engineering, sales, and logistics to translate customer requirements into practical product designs. The engineer will also support continuous improvement initiatives, ensure compliance with relevant standards, and contribute to innovation projects that enhance product reliability, sustainability, and efficiency.

**JOB PURPOSE**

We are looking for an Embedded Hardware and Software Development Engineer-to Design and implement Hardware and firmware of embedded devices. CE/EMI/EMC/IS certification

• Integrate and validate new product designs.

• New product development or New Technology.

• Upgradation of Existing product. KEY COMPETENCIES AND SKILLS

•

Gandhinagar

title: Senior Quality Assurance Officer
description:
**Company Description**
Shivayom Innovation & Research Lab Pvt. Ltd. is a state-of-the-art pharmaceutical testing laboratory specializing in accurate, reliable, and compliant testing for pharmaceutical and chemical products. The organization is committed to ensuring product quality, safety, and regulatory compliance for its clients through precision science and robust methodologies. Shivayom delivers trusted results that support the integrity of products in highly regulated markets. The laboratory environment emphasizes advanced technology, strict adherence to standards, and continuous improvement in testing practices.
  
**Role Description**
The Senior Quality Assurance Officer is a full-time, on-site role based in Chhatral, responsible for overseeing quality systems and ensuring adherence to regulatory and internal standards. Day-to-day tasks include reviewing and approving test methods and reports, monitoring quality control activities, conducting internal audits, and ensuring compliance with GMP, GLP, and other relevant guidelines. The role involves investigating and documenting non-conformities, coordinating CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Actions), and supporting validation and qualification activities for instruments and processes. The Senior Quality Assurance Officer will collaborate with laboratory teams to maintain documentation, optimize quality procedures, and support training related to quality and compliance.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong Quality Assurance and Quality Management skills to design, implement, and maintain robust quality systems and SOPs.
* Proficiency in Quality Control and Analytical Skills to review data, interpret results, and verify compliance with specifications and regulatory requirements.
* Experience in Quality Auditing, including conducting internal audits, identifying gaps, and recommending improvements.
* Sound knowledge of pharmaceutical testing regulations, GMP/GLP standards, and relevant national and international guidelines.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Microbiology, or a related scientific discipline.
* Demonstrated experience in a pharmaceutical or chemical testing laboratory, preferably in a senior or lead quality role.
* Excellent documentation, reporting, and communication skills, with attention to detail and strong problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and provide guidance on quality and compliance best practices.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a Quality Engineer with experience in pressure vessel and heat exchanger manufacturing. The candidate will be responsible for fabrication inspection, welding quality, material traceability, NDT coordination, and quality documentation in compliance with ASME Section VIII, Division 1 & 2, and applicable customer requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Carry out stage-wise quality inspections during the fabrication of pressure vessels, heat exchangers, and related equipment.

* Review engineering drawings, material specifications, approved procedures, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), and Quality Assurance Plans (QAPs).

* Perform incoming material inspection and verify Material Test Certificates (MTCs), material grades, identification, and traceability.

* Conduct fit-up, dimensional, visual welding, and final inspections as per approved drawings and applicable code requirements.

* Verify compliance with approved Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS), Procedure Qualification Records (PQR), and welder performance qualification records.

* Ensure weld identification, material traceability, and inspection records are maintained throughout manufacturing.

* Coordinate NDT activities, including RT, UT, MT, and PT, as required by the approved inspection plan and applicable code.

* Monitor hydrostatic testing and other applicable pressure tests, ensuring approved procedures and safety requirements are followed.

* Coordinate inspections with Authorized Inspection Agency (AIA) representatives, third-party inspectors, and customer inspectors, as applicable.

* Prepare and maintain inspection reports, non-conformance reports (NCRs), corrective action records, and manufacturing quality documentation.

* Support preparation and review of the final manufacturing data report and quality dossier, including applicable ASME documentation and the Manufacturer's Data Report (U-1 or applicable form).

* Ensure inspection hold points and witness points are followed and properly released.

* Identify quality issues, coordinate root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions to minimize rejection and rework.

* Support ASME U Stamp-related quality activities in accordance with the company's Quality Control System (QCS) and applicable code requirements.

* Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Procurement, and Project teams to resolve quality-related issues and ensure timely inspection clearance.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.

* 3–6 years of relevant experience in pressure vessel, heat exchanger, or process equipment manufacturing.

* Practical experience in fabrication quality control and inspection of welded pressure equipment.

* Working knowledge of ASME Section VIII, Division 1, and applicable material and welding requirements.

* Knowledge of welding inspection, WPS/PQR, welder qualifications, NDT, dimensional inspection, and material traceability.

* Experience in quality documentation, ITP/QAP implementation, NCR handling, and final inspection.

* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in an ASME U Stamp-certified manufacturing facility.

* NDT Level II certification in applicable methods.

* Welding inspection certification such as CSWIP or AWS-CWI.

* Familiarity with ASME material traceability, pressure testing, and Manufacturer's Data Report documentation.

* Knowledge of ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems.

We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets.  Ce Poste Se Concentre Sur Le Développement Structurel Des Fournisseurs. Il Intervient Au Cœur Des Fondamentaux Qui Conditionnent La Fiabilité D’un Fournisseur

* Robustesse organisationnelle, documentaire et suivi des sous\-traitants

* Les fournisseurs stratégiques pour l’entreprise

* Rédiger des rapports structurés, argumentés et exploitables
* Assurer l’interface avec les experts techniques internes pour coordonner les actions fournisseurs
* Construire avec les fournisseurs des plans de développement pragmatiques et mesurables (actions, échéances, indicateurs)
* Contribuer à la montée en maturité du panel fournisseurs : accompagnement Lean, coaching, suivi des actions et évaluation de leur efficacité
* Promouvoir les bonnes pratiques dans le respect des règles de confidentialité
* Construire et améliorer les standards de qualification, de maturité et les programmes de développement fournisseurs, en favorisant les synergies avec les entités du groupe EDF


**Compétences techniques**
